# Verbs and callable helpers

Alphabetical reference for the public verb namespace, including compatibility helpers and clearly labeled placeholders. Factories return pipe stages; direct helpers accept data arguments instead. The Usage and Returns sections describe each distinction. `near()` is not implemented.

| Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| [align_cube](align_cube.md) | Align a cube to another cube's grid. |
| [anomaly](anomaly.md) | Return a pipe verb that subtracts the mean over dim. |
| [aoi_signature](aoi_signature.md) | Summarize an AOI cube into a named spatial-unit time signature. |
| [apply](apply.md) | Return a verb that applies func to the incoming cube. |
| [binary_state](binary_state.md) | Normalize an existing boolean mask into a state cube. |
| [block_signature](block_signature.md) | Summarize a local cube into a named block time signature. |
| [change_state](change_state.md) | Convert lagged absolute or relative change to a state cube. |
| [climate_hist](climate_hist.md) | Plot climate distributions inside vs outside the event footprint. |
| [collect_blocks](collect_blocks.md) | Collect block signatures into one block collection. |
| [compare_aoi_signature](compare_aoi_signature.md) | Compare one AOI signature with another over shared time. |
| [compare_blocks](compare_blocks.md) | Compare all unique pairs in a block collection. |
| [correlation_cube](correlation_cube.md) | Factory placeholder for a future correlation cube operation. |
| [detect_events](detect_events.md) | Detect contiguous state runs as events. |
| [diagnostic_panel](diagnostic_panel.md) | Create a static PNG-ready diagnostic panel for a cube or fire result. |
| [duration_synchrony](duration_synchrony.md) | Compare durations of one-to-one matched events. |
| [exceedance](exceedance.md) | Alias for :func:threshold_state. |
| [extract](extract.md) | Attach canonical fire hull and climate summaries to a cube. |
| [fire_derivative](fire_derivative.md) | Fire derivative hull visualization verb. |
| [fire_panel](fire_panel.md) | Return the fire analysis bundle plus figure objects for custom layouts. |
| [fire_plot](fire_plot.md) | Fire time-hull + climate visualization workflow. |
| [fire_vase_panel](fire_vase_panel.md) | Build a multi-event VASE panel for prescribed burns. |
| [fit_model](fit_model.md) | Placeholder for upcoming modeling verbs. |
| [flatten_cube](flatten_cube.md) | Flatten all non-time dimensions into a single sample dimension. |
| [flatten_space](flatten_space.md) | Flatten spatial dimensions (y and x) into a pixel dimension. |
| [landsat8_mpc](landsat8_mpc.md) | Lazy import wrapper for the Landsat MPC helper. |
| [landsat_ndvi_plot](landsat_ndvi_plot.md) | Lazy import wrapper for Landsat NDVI plotting. |
| [landsat_vis_ndvi](landsat_vis_ndvi.md) | Lazy import wrapper for a visualization-friendly Landsat NDVI cube. |
| [mean](mean.md) | Compute the mean along a dimension while keeping cubes pipe-ready. |
| [month_filter](month_filter.md) | Deprecated. Use :func:cubedynamics.verbs.month_filter instead. |
| [ndvi_from_s2](ndvi_from_s2.md) | Factory returning a Sentinel-2 NDVI transform for pipe chains. |
| [occurrence_synchrony](occurrence_synchrony.md) | Measure whether states occur at the same times across locations. |
| [overlap](overlap.md) | Return a verb that finds coincident truth in two aligned state cubes. |
| [plot](plot.md) | Plot a cube using the CubePlot grammar and keep the cube flowing. |
| [plot_mean](plot_mean.md) | Plot mean and variance cubes with synchronized controls. |
| [quantile_state](quantile_state.md) | Convert raw values to a state cube using quantile thresholds. |
| [rasterize_observations](rasterize_observations.md) | Rasterize observation rows into a biological cube. |
| [rolling_median_split_synchrony](rolling_median_split_synchrony.md) | Compute rolling synchrony in lower and upper per-series sets. |
| [rolling_tail_dep_vs_center](rolling_tail_dep_vs_center.md) | Return a rolling "tail dependence vs center" contrast along dim. |
| [severity_synchrony](severity_synchrony.md) | Measure magnitude co-variation during jointly active states. |
| [show_cube_lexcube](show_cube_lexcube.md) | Render a Lexcube widget as a side-effect and return the original cube. |
| [sync_with](sync_with.md) | Compare one aligned state cube with another. |
| [threshold_state](threshold_state.md) | Convert raw values to a standard state cube using a threshold. |
| [timing_synchrony](timing_synchrony.md) | Measure whether one-to-one matched events happen at similar times. |
| [to_netcdf](to_netcdf.md) | Factory for a pipeable .to_netcdf side-effect operation. |
| [tubes](tubes.md) | High-level verb: find suitability tubes and plot one as a vase. |
| [variance](variance.md) | Return a variance reducer along dim with optional dimension retention. |
| [vase](vase.md) | Plot either a generic VaseDefinition or a fire TimeHull-derived vase. |
| [vase_demo](vase_demo.md) | Convenience verb: build a demo stacked-polygon vase and plot it. |
| [vase_extract](vase_extract.md) | Mask a cube so that values outside the vase become NaN. |
| [vase_mask](vase_mask.md) | Compute a boolean vase mask for a time-varying polygon hull. |
| [zscore](zscore.md) | Return a standardized anomaly verb (z-score) along dim. |
